Date: 02/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 115 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Public Health by an undetermined amount to establish and administer a community paramedicine program; however, this increase may be offset, in whole or in part, by license fees collected by the Department for community paramedic licensees.
Jim McClendon, Chairperson
Healthcare
